description: Write a pending change request instead of changing the site: title, summary, rationale, 1–20 changes and optional rule ids. Read get_site view=cms first and propose only writableFields; unsupported fields are manual. The owner approves or rejects in the console; rejection notes come back through list_proposals. Does not modify the site or consume an audit run. Requires audits:write and an account-owned key. An identical pending proposal returns the existing row (deduplicated=true).

rationale.description: The evidence chain: findings, rules, pages and expected effect

ruleIds.description: Optional rule ids this proposal addresses

summary.description: One-paragraph statement of what should change and why it matters

targetUrl.description: Optional page URL; must be http(s) and on the site's domain

name: propose_fix
title: Propose a fix for human review
